description: A visual representation of a product that provides information about its appearance, design, and visual characteristics.

visual_description.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and provide a detailed description of what the product looks like, including shape, design, and overall appearance.

colors.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and list all colors visible in the product.

primary_color.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and identify the dominant color of the product.

materials.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and identify visible materials the product appears to be made of (e.g., metal, plastic, wood, glass).

visible_features.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and list visible product features and components.

visible_text.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and extract any text visible on the product or packaging.

product_condition.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and determine the apparent condition of the product (new, used, etc.).

environment.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and describe the environment or setting in which the product is displayed.

size_impression.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and provide an impression of the product's size (small, medium, large) based on context.

categories.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and identify product categories this item appears to belong to.

keywords.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and suggest relevant search terms for the product based on its visual appearance.

style.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and identify the style or design aesthetic of the product (modern, traditional, industrial, etc.).

target_audience.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and identify the apparent intended audience based on visual design (e.g., professionals, children, etc.).

logo_present.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and determine whether a logo is visible on the product.

packaging_visible.instruction: Please analyze the following product image and determine whether the product packaging is visible in the image.
